title: Stochastic analysis of Beckner's and related functional inequalities
summary: Beckner's inequality is a family of inequalities that interpolates the two fundamental functional inequalities, the logarithmic Sobolev and Poincaré's inequalities. It is parametrized by exponent $p\in (1,2]$ and it implies the logarithmic Sobolev inequality as $p\to 1$ and agrees with Poincaré's inequality when $p=2$. In this paper, employing a stochastic method, we prove an improvement of Beckner's inequality under the Gaussian measure when $4/3\le p<2$; in particular, when $p=3/2$, the error bound is expressed in terms of the entropy functional.
